difficulty: table with merged cells (rowspan and colspan) and a caption
title: Regional Shipments, First Half of 2025
key_sentences: The table below shows how many units left our two warehouses in the first two quarters of 2025.
Figures are counted at the moment of dispatch.
Shipments of pumps grew in both regions from the first quarter to the second.
The northern warehouse remains the larger of the two.

tables.caption: Table 2. Shipments by region and product line (units)

notes: Grid is 7 rows x 4 columns with TWO header rows (rows 1-2). Merged cells, repeated in every grid cell they span: 'Region' rowspan=2 (rows 1-2, col 1); 'Product line' rowspan=2 (rows 1-2, col 2); 'Shipments' colspan=2 (row 1, cols 3-4); 'North' rowspan=2 (rows 3-4, col 1); 'South' rowspan=2 (rows 5-6, col 1); 'Total' colspan=2 (row 7, cols 1-2). The caption is rendered above the table. Totals are arithmetically correct (column sums).
